reviewContext.issueReference: workflowInput:issueTitle='x-gateway: move to swift-crypto 5.x' (no issueUrl/issueNumber; workflowInput issueBody is authoritative)
reviewContext.userProblem: Riela pins x-gateway with an exact version tag and must resolve one apple/swift-crypto 5.x version across its dependency graph. x-gateway currently requires "3.0.0"..<"5.0.0" (Package.swift:29), and Package.resolved pins swift-crypto 4.5.2.
requiredOutcomes: Package.resolved, refreshed by 'swift package update swift-crypto', pins swift-crypto 5.x >= 5.0.3
Any compile error or deprecation that swift-crypto 5 introduces is fixed without behavior change
Hashing and signing output stays byte-for-byte identical against the existing oracles
VERSION and the XGatewayCore.swift version constant are both bumped from 0.1.26 to 0.1.27
swift build, swift test, mise run test and mise run lint pass
The final commit is pushed to origin/main, then tag v0.1.27 is created on that pushed commit and pushed
nonGoals: Do not publish a GitHub release, Homebrew/Cask formula, npm package or Nix release
Do not add swift-asn1 or any other direct dependency
Do not add crypto wrapper or abstraction layers
Do not edit the test or smoke-test oracle expectations
constraints: Use only the targeted 'swift package update swift-crypto'; no bare 'swift package update' and no hand-editing of Package.resolved
Keep swift-tools-version 5.8 and .macOS(.v13) unless the design's blocker or finding rules require a change
If any dependency caps swift-crypto below 5, report the exact constraint as a blocker and make no workaround
If the local toolchain is too old for swift-crypto 5.x, or 5.x needs macOS above 13, report a blocker and stop
Run SwiftPM commands serially; the version-bump plan runs no swift commands during wave 1
Workers do not run git write operations; finalization commits, pushes and tags serially
designDecisionsAndRationale: Requirement is from: "5.0.3", which admits all 5.x and rejects 3.x/4.x, so Riela can unify on a single 5.x version (architecture.md#third-party-dependency-baseline)
Keep the CryptoKit/Crypto import split in OAuth1.swift and XGatewayOAuth2.swift, and the unconditional import Crypto in XGatewayResourceUsage.swift, unless 5.x fails to compile without a change
A dependency-only change bumps the patch version in both VERSION and XGatewayCore.swift, and the tag is created on the pushed main HEAD (architecture.md#versioning-and-tagging)
intentionalTradeoffs: The Linux 'import Crypto' branch in OAuth1.swift and XGatewayOAuth2.swift is not compiled on macOS. This is accepted as a recorded verification gap instead of requiring a Linux build.
The version bump runs in parallel with the dependency plan and does not build on its own. Integration covers build and test of the version constant.
supportedEdgeCases: No source change needed when swift-crypto 5 compiles cleanly
Minimal call-site edit when swift-crypto 5 renames or deprecates an API used at the three crypto sites
swift-asn1 transitive pin moves only if SwiftPM moves it
Root tools-version raised only to the minimum SwiftPM accepts, recorded as a finding
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Linux build verification of the #else import Crypto branch
macOS deployment target above 13 (blocker for a maintainer decision)
Release packaging surfaces (dist/, Formula/, packaging/, scripts/, flake.nix, mise.toml)

acceptanceCriteria: Package.swift swift-crypto requirement is exactly from: "5.0.3" with no '..<' range; one-line diff
Package.resolved swift-crypto version matches ^5\. and is >= 5.0.3, generated by 'swift package update swift-crypto'
Progress Log records swift-crypto 5.x tools-version, platforms (or none), swift-asn1 requirement and 'swift --version'
swift build exits 0 with no crypto-related deprecation warnings
Crypto call-site edits exist only where justified by an exact compiler message; public signatures unchanged
swift test and mise run test exit 0 with log paths and exit statuses recorded
Tests and Sources/XGatewaySwiftSmokeTests are unchanged (git diff --exit-code)
VERSION contains exactly 0.1.27 with one trailing newline
Sources/XGatewayCore/XGatewayCore.swift has exactly one '"version": "0.1.27"' in the version group and no other change
grep -rn '0\.1\.26' VERSION Sources produces no output
git diff --stat shows 2 files changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
No swift build/test is run in wave 1
